name: task from a stated deadline
input: i need to renew my passport on march 15th
criteria: Calls task_create with a short title about renewing a passport
Sets the due date to March 15 in the next year it comes around from the current date
Does not call remember, and does not ask permission first

name: remember an explicit fact
input: remember that I'm allergic to penicillin
criteria: Calls remember exactly once with the penicillin allergy
Does not ask permission first and does not create a task

name: checks memory before denying
criteria: Calls search_memories or list_memories instead of claiming it has no memory of the user
